name: Shoujo Dominance -Dokusen Yoku no Tsuyo Sugiru Manamusume Reina-
original_name: 少女ドミナンス -独占欲の強すぎる愛娘 玲奈-
source:
Love blooms as Reina goes searching for the right person, only to find out that love has always been nearby.

When her friends ask, "What kind of person is your ideal type?" the first figure that comes to mind is her father. Reina wants nothing more than to have somebody who will cherish and protect her.

"I'm sure he already knows what I want… so why won't he just do it?"

[From [url=https://jastusa.com/shoujo-dominance-my-precious-reina]Jast USA[/url]]
translation:
蕾娜寻找对的人，却发现爱情一直就在身边，爱情绽放。

当朋友问“你的理想型是什么样的人？”第一个想到的人物就是她的父亲。雷娜最想要的就是有一个珍惜她、保护她的人。

“我确信他已经知道我想要什么……那他为什么不直接做呢？”

[来自[url=https://jastusa.com/shoujo-dominance-my-precious-reina]Jast USA[/url]]
